title: GitHub launches Copilot Fusion as agents start 40% of pull requests
content:
GitHub launched Copilot Fusion at GitHub Universe, its developer conference, on Wednesday. The system decides which AI model, or mix of models, should handle each step of a coding task. It weighs what the task needs across reasoning, code generation, debugging and tool use. Jay Parikh, executive vice president of CoreAI at Microsoft, described it in a GitHub blog post.
Parikh wrote that Fusion Max scored within two points of Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 Max on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index. It did so at half the cost and with 40% less time per task. In a LinkedIn post, Microsoft chief executive Satya Nadella said Fusion delivers frontier-level quality 40% faster and at up to 77% lower cost.
SDLC is the software development life cycle, the path from planning through coding, testing and release. Nadella also said the unified system that runs Copilot’s agents is now in Foundry. Foundry is Microsoft’s managed service for building long-running agents. In September, a group of coders lost their DMCA case against Copilot at the Ninth Circuit.
Copilot without a separate subscription
From Wednesday, GitHub Enterprise customers can use every Copilot feature without buying a separate subscription. They pay for the AI credits they use. The offer runs through GitHub’s sales team for now, with self-serve coming soon. Existing Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise customers can keep their plans or switch when they choose.
GitHub also showed the GitHub Copilot app, which connects agents and tools across projects. Inside it, Copilot projects run agent work across several repositories in parallel managed sessions. Session continuity lets one cloud agent session move between the app, VS Code, the command line and the web.
Copilot automations can now learn from their results and propose changes for developers to approve. Microsoft added coding to its own Copilot app, a separate product, in September.
For review, GitHub added Copilot code review Max. The company says it posted the highest F1 score on ReviewBench for high-severity issues. Startups sell AI code review too. CodeRabbit raised $143m in August to check code written by AI.
More capacity for agents
This year GitHub has added 4 million CPU cores and 160 PB of high-speed storage, Parikh wrote. It has added 50 Tb/s of network capacity too. GitHub is moving to a multi-region deployment on Microsoft’s Azure and expects to finish early next year. Nadella said the work will make GitHub more resilient.
“I think all the software we’ve written to date will amount to less than 1% of the software we’ll write in the next five years,” Parikh wrote.
What the Octoverse numbers show
GitHub published its annual Octoverse report on the same day. Developers pushed code 17.9 billion times in the 12 months to 30 September. That is more than in 2024 and 2025 combined. Commits reached 34.3 billion and merged pull requests 1.3 billion.
By September, more than 40% of pull requests started with a draft from an agent, up from 17% in March. That was 110 million in September alone. Activity rose sharply around June, when agents began working across days and running in the cloud, according to the report. GitHub says its agent count is a floor, because it cannot detect every agent.
The platform now has more than 225 million developers. The United States has 38.3 million and India 32 million. In September, 61% of Copilot users who picked their own model used more than one. TypeScript remained the most used language, and Rust grew fastest among the top languages, doubling in a year.

report.summary: GitHub推出Copilot Fusion多模型路由系统，代理已发起超40%的PR
report.background: GitHub在年度开发者大会Universe上发布Copilot Fusion。当前AI编程代理快速普及：2025年3月仅17%的拉取请求由代理起草，9月已超40%；Claude、GPT等模型各有所长，成本和延迟成为企业采用的主要瓶颈。微软正将代理运行体系整合进Foundry托管服务；2025年9月第九巡回法院驳回针对Copilot的DMCA诉讼，也为AI编程工具扫清了法律障碍。
key_points: Fusion根据推理、代码生成、调试、工具调用等环节动态选择或混合模型，Fusion Max在Artificial Analysis编码代理指数上与Claude Opus 5.5 Max仅差2分，成本减半、耗时少40%。
微软CEO纳德拉称其以前沿级质量实现快40%、成本最高降77%；统一运行Copilot代理的系统已进入微软Foundry托管服务。
GitHub Enterprise客户无需单独订阅即可使用全部Copilot功能，改为按AI credits付费；现有Business/Enterprise用户可自选保留或切换。
Octoverse报告显示：过去12个月代码推送179亿次，超过2024和2025两年之和；超40%的PR始于代理草稿，9月单月达1.1亿次。
平台今年新增400万CPU核、160PB高速存储及50Tb/s网络，正迁移至Azure多区域部署；开发者总数超2.25亿，61%自选模型的用户使用多模型。
report.impact: 对AI行业：多模型路由与编排成为新竞争焦点，单一模型性能优势被成本、延迟和组合能力稀释。对开发者：代理从辅助工具升级为PR主力来源，并行会话、代码审查与跨端连续性提升交付效率，但需加强审核代理输出、管理AI用量成本。对普通用户：软件迭代更快、成本更低，同时对AI生成代码的质量与安全审查提出更高要求，企业采购从订阅制转向按用量付费。
report.tools: 可关注GitHub Copilot Fusion（Enterprise试用）、Copilot应用与VS Code/CLI/Web会话连续性、Copilot code review Max、微软Foundry代理托管服务；对比CodeRabbit等AI代码审查工具，并用Artificial Analysis编码代理指数做模型选型与成本评估。
